description: The live ChainHelix signal stream, newest first. Each signal names chain, direction, entry price and a conviction score with its ranking tier, and each one is sealed on the opBNB chain before its outcome exists, typically within 5 minutes of being issued and at most about 30 minutes, so the record cannot be edited afterward. sealedAt is the time the signal was issued, committedAt the time its seal was written on chain. Verify any of them with the free proof tools. Optional chain, and limit up to 50. Price: 6 cents per call.

chain.description: Chain name, one of bitcoin, ethereum, bnb, solana, avalanche, xrp, tron, polygon, sui; absent = every chain. Example: bnb

limit.description: Number of signals, whole number 1 to 50, default 12. Example: 20

name: latest_signals
